quote_json: "if E is classified as a read-only local variable"
notes: csc at language version 7.3 accepts the address of a foreach iteration variable without a diagnostic. ECMA-334 7th ed 23.6.5, p. 558 requires a compile-time error for the address of a read-only local variable, and 13.9.5 classifies the iteration variable as read-only. This wording is unchanged in draft-v8 and the secondary alpha-v13 text. No conforming later language version was found from 8.0 through 15.0.

The secondary alpha-v13 text instead says the result is implementation-defined and no exception is required, which would permit this behavior. No adopted edition has adopted that wording. The csc behavior is unchanged from language version 8.0 through 15.0, with no conforming later language version found.
